title: HeatmapSnapshot
description: Current heatmap for an event: positions counted per grid cell and per zone. Pushed by processing-server to the dashboard as the SignalR message HeatmapUpdated on /hubs/heatmap, and returned by GET /heatmap. Counts currently accumulate from when processing-server started and are never reset. Known gap (planned v2): the snapshot carries no eventId or zoneId, only names.

eventName.description: Name of the event the snapshot belongs to.

minLat.description: Latitude of the grid origin (south-west corner of cell x = 0, y = 0).

minLon.description: Longitude of the grid origin (south-west corner of cell x = 0, y = 0).

cellSizeLat.description: Height of a grid cell in degrees of latitude.

cellSizeLon.description: Width of a grid cell in degrees of longitude.

cells.description: Grid cells with at least one position. Empty cells are left out.

zones.description: Position count for each of the event's zones. Empty if the event has no zones.

Cell.description: A grid cell identified by its index from the grid origin. The cell centre is at latitude minLat + (y + 0.5) * cellSizeLat and longitude minLon + (x + 0.5) * cellSizeLon.

x.description: Column index, counted eastwards from minLon.

y.description: Row index, counted northwards from minLat.

count.description: Number of positions in the cell.

ZoneCount.description: Position count for one zone. The dashboard notifies the event holder at 90 % of capacity and marks the zone when capacity is exceeded.

capacity.description: Maximum number of participants, or null if the zone has no capacity.

count.description: Number of positions counted inside the zone.
